name: orchestration
description: Orchestration suite for agent harnesses: manager (persistent tier-dispatch role), team (multi-agent rounds in worktrees), brainstorm (decision exploration), spec (deliverable+check specifications), parallel (wave-scheduled execution of a spec).

interface.shortDescription: Manager, team, brainstorm, spec and parallel skills for agent orchestration
interface.longDescription: Five skills that share one pipeline: brainstorm explores a decision (recon dispatch, batched questions with recommendations, decision log), spec turns it into deliverables each with a check that can fail, parallel executes the spec as disjoint wave-scheduled units, team runs multi-agent rounds in worktrees, and manager is the persistent tier-dispatch role the others build on.
defaultPrompt: brainstorm whether this cache should be shared
